subject.why: Golden gem-studded goblet with pearl rim on a pedestal matches the brief.

category.why: Features a stylized podium surface and a clean gradient background wall.

clean.why: Free of text, UI, logos, and characters.

framing.why: Central composition with clear margins around the goblet.
